errors.says: Method: choose the labels 'so that gather and scatter coefficients depend on the intersection size and the only decreasing edges are the central-wire returns'.
errors.paper: Intersection-dependent coefficients belong to the scalar gates (689-703, 752-758), not to the labels. The labels are chosen so that neighbouring triple lines are orthogonal (869-870), every edge joins nested labels, and the only decrease is the central return from A(x)F to B(x)F (945-958, 975-988).

errors.says: Over F_2 every nonzero residual contains a norm-one coordinate unit.
errors.paper: The norm-one vector in a residual is a tensor of chosen norm-one vectors: coordinate units in some factors, but the triple-line vectors of P and Q in others. It is generally not a coordinate unit of F^{otimes3} (1073-1085).

errors.says: No extra source ranks are needed, 'so the deficit is larger than in the bit network'.
errors.paper: The paper only states the deficit 2N-2L_c>0 (1260). The absolute deficit is indeed larger, but the relative deficit that fixes the exponent is smaller for the complex network: eta_c=73/19906842167500 < eta_b=339/22587335000000 (1319-1324). The added comparison could mislead.

errors.says: For widths differing by one bit, the leading bit is moved out, the equal-width parts are interchanged, and the single bit is moved back.
errors.paper: Each case uses exactly one single-bit move, before or after the equal-width interchange depending on which chunk is longer. The bit ends at a new position, (h_0,H,g,D)->(h_0,D,g,H)->(D,g,h_0,H); it is not moved back (1740-1761).

errors.says: With A=S' and B_0=D'J'C, the normalizations give B_0 P_t F_t A=2^{-2 alpha^2} P_s F_s.
errors.paper: This requires the left-inverse step: C T=N D^{-1}, so (D N^{-1} C) T=I, and applying it to T P_s F_s=P_t F_t S gives D N^{-1} C P_t F_t S=P_s F_s. Only then do the normalizations give the identity (3626-3641). The plan omits this step; it is a gap rather than a misstatement.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound: two tape procedures from one network (bank exchange, frames, subspace labels, rank saving s<Wm, recursion), then the synthetic transforms and ring convolution, resampling with chirp and permutation cancellation, the six-step algorithm with exact recovery, and the time table with min margin 2 kappa. It thins out at the start of the network: the fixed sizes h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3, m=h^3, the triple indexing and the neighbour rules are never stated, and the gate-label and residual tables behind the label lemma are skipped, so comparability and the single decreasing edge are asserted from quotes rather than shown. The left-inverse step of the resampling identity is also missing.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch wire restored is fully present and proved. But the defining sizes h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3, m=h^3 and the indexing of the data pairs by triples are never stated. Conservatively, mentioned.
A common frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, the network implements D_out S D_in^{-1}, and each edge pays only D_v D_u^{-1}.

Nondegenerate subspaces of F^{otimes3} built from triple indicators. Every edge joins comparable labels, and the only decreasing edges are central 3->4, each losing h (P(x)F(x)Q). Dimension m is implicit from F=Q^h.
For nested nondegenerate U in V, P_V-P_U has rank dim V-dim U. The N source edges 2P_{U_a} are rank-one exceptions.
The sum of |Delta dim| is Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, by telescoping at gates, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L/N=100/539 and 101/539, both below 1/2. The deficit is N-2L_b>0, so s_b<W_b m (and 2N-2L_c>0 for the complex network).
The endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m, and I_m on other roles, so the network applies H<-H+D on every role, scratch rows included.
A=E_1 Pi E_2 gives a rank-a shear as exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and each node makes exactly s recursive calls.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20, and F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the central saving almost completely: frames, nested labels with one decreasing edge type, rank equal to dimension change with the N source exceptions, the budget Wm-2N+2L and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, the strict deficit from L/N<1/2, the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D, edges as exactly s recursive calls, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The one gap is the fixed network's sizes and indexing (h=100, triples, N, m), so C1 is only mentioned; 8 of 9 steps are reconstructed.
